analysis: Thomas Partey delivered a masterclass in distribution, anchoring Arsenal’s buildup with exceptional passing accuracy that allowed the team to maintain control and tempo throughout the full 90 minutes. While his defensive interventions in tackles and interceptions were modest, his high block rating suggests he effectively positioned himself to cut off passing lanes rather than engaging in frequent ground duels. This disciplined, risk-averse approach highlights his role as a stabilizing pivot who prioritizes ball retention and structural integrity over aggressive ball recovery.
